source.note: Generated from Genshin Optimizer sheets (master) + allStat_gen skillParam. Hit keys match GO target paths; multKey = <hitKey>_mult. Levels: Lv10, except constellation-boosted talents of 4-star characters at Lv13 (C6 assumed). Normal/charged/plunging default to physical unless the sheet overrides the element (infusions are NOT applied). Unparsed GO formulas (add manually if needed): ['skill.inheritedHp: skipped (helper/cond formula)'].

self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: A4 Precise Shot: hitting a weak point with a fully-charged Aimed Shot increases ATK by 15% for 10s.

C2 Bunny Triggered: manually detonating Baron Bunny with a fully-charged Aimed Shot deals 200% additional DMG on that explosion. Approximated as a flat bonus to the existing Explosive Puppet skill-DMG hit rather than a separate detonation hit.

team_conditional_modifiers_json.description: C6 Wildfire: Fiery Rain increases all party members' ATK by 15% for 10s.

auto.name: Sharpshooter
auto.desc:
<k>Normal Attack</k>
Performs up to 5 consecutive shots with a bow.

<k>Charged Attack</k>
Performs a more precise <k>Aimed Shot</k> with increased DMG.
While aiming, flames will accumulate on the arrowhead. A fully charged flaming arrow will deal <e:pyro>Pyro DMG</e>.

<k>Plunging Attack</k>
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skill.name: Explosive Puppet
skill.desc: The ever-reliable Baron Bunny takes the stage. Baron Bunny · Continuously taunts the enemy, drawing their fire. · Baron Bunny's HP scales with Amber's Max HP. · When destroyed or when its timer expires, Baron Bunny explodes, dealing AoE Pyro DMG. Hold Adjusts the throwing direction of Baron Bunny. The longer the button is held, the further the throw. Baron Bunny hails from a storied lineage, but Amber has stopped keeping count since Baron Bunny the 893rd.

burst.name: Fiery Rain
burst.desc: Fires off a shower of arrows, dealing continuous AoE Pyro DMG. Amber's passion truly burns hot.

passives.name: Every Arrow Finds Its Target
passives.desc: Increases the CRIT Rate of <k>Fiery Rain</k> by 10% and widens its AoE by 30%.

passives.name: Precise Shot
passives.desc: Aimed Shot hits on weak points increase ATK by 15% for 10s.

passives.name: Gliding Champion
passives.desc:
Decreases gliding Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.

constellations.name: One Arrow to Rule Them All
constellations.desc: Fires 2 arrows per <k>Aimed Shot</k>. The second arrow deals 20% of the first arrow's DMG.

constellations.name: Bunny Triggered
constellations.desc:
Baron Bunny, new and improved! Hitting Baron Bunny's foot with a fully-charged Aimed Shot manually detonates it.
Explosion via manual detonation deals 200% additional DMG.

constellations.name: It Burns!
constellations.desc:
Increases the Level of <k>Fiery Rain</k> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: It's Not Just Any Doll...
constellations.desc: Decreases <k>Explosive Puppet</k>'s CD by 20%. Adds 1 additional charge.

constellations.name: It's Baron Bunny!
constellations.desc:
Increases the Level of <k>Explosive Puppet</k> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Wildfire
constellations.desc: <k>Fiery Rain</k> increases all party members' Movement SPD by 15% and ATK by 15% for 10s.

auto.name: Archerie revisitée
auto.desc:
<k>Attaque normale</k>
Enchaîne jusqu'à 5 tirs consécutifs.

<k>Attaque chargée</k>
Effectue un <k>tir visé</k> plus précis infligeant davantage de DGT.
Lors de la visée, la flèche se charge en élément Pyro, infligeant de considérables <e:pyro>DGT Pyro</e> quand elle est complètement chargée.

<k>Attaque plongeante</k>
Tire une pluie de flèches depuis les airs et plonge au sol, infligeant des DGT de zone à l'impact.

skill.name: Poupée explosive
skill.desc: Le fidèle Baron Lapinou est déployé sur le terrain. Baron Lapinou · Le Baron nargue les ennemis proches et attire leur attention. · Ses PV sont proportionnels aux PV max d'Amber. · Le Baron explose à la fin ou s'il est détruit entre temps, et inflige des DGT Pyro de zone. Appui long Ajuste la direction du jet. Ajuste la portée du jet. La lignée de Baron Lapinou est impressionnante, mais Amber a décidé d'arrêter de compter à partir du 893e Baron Lapinou.

burst.name: Pluie de flèches
burst.desc: Tire une pluie de flèches qui inflige des DGT Pyro continus. Amber est une fille chaleureuse et pleine de passion.

passives.name: Dans le mille !
passives.desc: Augmente le taux CRIT de <k>Pluie de flèches</k> de 10 % et la zone d'effet de 30 %.

passives.name: Tir précis
passives.desc: L'ATQ augmente de 15 % pendant 10 s lorsque le tir visé touche un point faible.

passives.name: Championne de planage
passives.desc:
Diminue la consommation d'endurance de vos personnages dans l'équipe de 20 % lors du planage.
Ne peut pas être cumulé avec d'autres aptitudes passives aux effets identiques.

constellations.name: Une flèche suffit !
constellations.desc: Tire 2 flèches consécutives à chaque <k>tir visé</k>. La seconde flèche inflige 20 % des DGT de la première.

constellations.name: Tout est prêt
constellations.desc:
Une toute nouvelle modification du Baron Lapinou ! Un tir visé à pleine charge aux pieds du Baron Lapinou, et ce dernier explose directement...
Ce type d'explosion inflige 200 % de DGT supplémentaires.

constellations.name: Ça brûle !
constellations.desc:
Niveau d'aptitude <k>Pluie de flèches</k> +3.
Niveau max : 15

constellations.name: Ce n'est pas n'importe quelle poupée...
constellations.desc: Diminue le TdR de <k>Poupée explosive</k> de 20 % et permet de l'utiliser une fois supplémentaire.

constellations.name: Feu sauvage
constellations.desc: <k>Pluie de flèches</k> augmente la VIT de déplacement de tous les personnages de l'équipe de 15 % et leur ATQ de 15 % pendant 10 s.
